label: prf:confinement-categorical
title: Proof of confinement categorical
html:
Proof. Transport everything along the Wedderburn isomorphism \Phi : A \xrightarrow{\sim} \prod_\lambda \mathrm{Mat}_{f^\lambda}(K), which holds because q is not a root of unity. Write x_\lambda for the \lambda-block of \Phi(x), so \mathrm{tr}(\rho_\lambda x) = \mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda), and \pi_Z(x) = \Phi^{-1}\bigl((\mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda)/f^\lambda)\, 1_\lambda\bigr)_\lambda as in the statement. This uses f^\lambda \neq 0 in K.

(1) Each block of \Phi(\pi_Z(x)) is a scalar matrix, and scalar matrices commute with everything in their block, so \Phi(\pi_Z(x)) is central in the product and \pi_Z(x) \in Z(A). It equals \sum_\lambda (\mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda)/f^\lambda)\, e_\lambda.

(2) A trace on a matrix algebra \mathrm{Mat}_f(K) is a scalar multiple of \mathrm{tr}, because it vanishes on commutators and the commutators together with one diagonal unit span. Hence \tau \circ \Phi^{-1} is a sum of block traces \sum_\lambda c_\lambda\, \mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda), and evaluating at e_\lambda gives c_\lambda f^\lambda = \tau(e_\lambda) = \mu_\lambda. So \tau(x) = \sum_\lambda \mu_\lambda\, \mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda)/f^\lambda. The same formula applied to \pi_Z(x), whose \lambda-block has trace \mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda), gives \tau(\pi_Z(x)) = \tau(x).

(3) If x is central, each x_\lambda commutes with all of \mathrm{Mat}_{f^\lambda}(K) and is therefore a scalar s_\lambda\, 1. Then \mathrm{tr}(x_\lambda)/f^\lambda = s_\lambda and \pi_Z(x) = x. \square

Reading Z(A) as the E_\infty^{0,0} page of the GB-filtration spectral sequence additionally uses \mathrm{HH}^k(A) = 0 for k \geq 1 (spectral sequence collapse); that reading is not part of the proof.

Confinement reading.

Each clause is the categorical reflection of a confinement statement in QCD:

Clause Algebra QCD analogue
(1) \pi_Z sends every element into the centre Z(A) Free quarks not observed
(2) every trace \tau factors through \pi_Z All observables are gauge-invariant
(3) \pi_Z fixes every central x Colour-singlet states are unchanged by the projection

The curvature 2-cocycle F encoding the Hecke + Yang–Baxter relations (curvature-rank stratification) plays the role of the string tension categorically: F is the obstruction to extracting a non-central element through the GB filtration, just as the QCD string tension is the obstruction to extracting an isolated quark.

Curvature-rank as confinement layer.

The strata J^k / J^{k+1} index confinement layers: higher k corresponds to greater commutator depth and stronger obstruction to extraction. At k = 0 (the centre) elements carry no commutator load; at k \geq 1 they lie in the k-th commutator stratum. The chirality channel D_q^2 = 0 supplies the persistent gauge-invariant background analogous to the gluon condensate.

Predictive consequence.

The hadron mass formula (unified mass formula) \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}} = \sum_k \alpha_k \cdot \mathfrak{m}^{(k)}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(1) is, read through this proposition, a sum over confinement layers. Term k of the formula is the contribution of the curvature-rank-k confinement stratum. The rank-3 chirality residue (\mathrm{Vol}(6_1) \cdot |(q;q)_3|) and the rank-\geq 4 universal Pochhammer tail in the structural \mathfrak{Q}_\beta derivation are confinement residues, not independent ingredients.
